jokes: Why did the headache go to school? It wanted to be a little less tense.
I told my headache a joke, but it just kept pounding away at the punchline.
Why did the brain take a holiday? It needed some peace and quiet.
What do you call a headache that loves music? A real head-banger, in the gentlest way.
Why did the pillow get promoted? It was always so supportive.
I asked my headache to leave, but it said it was just trying to get ahead.
Why is rest the best guest? It never overstays its welcome when you invite it properly.
What did the water say to the headache? Take a sip, sit down, and let me help you feel a little clearer.
